examples.text: ke ca te ataruṃ paṅkaṃ, maccudheyyaṃ suduttaraṃ, ke hitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ, dibbayogaṃ upaccagun'ti.
kadā nu kho yaṃ viditaṃ mah'esinā, cattāri saccāni sududdasāni, samāhit'atto satimā agacchaṃ, paññāya taṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

63901.meaning1: extremely difficult to find; very rare to get

63902.meaning1: well preached; well taught; well explained; well instructed

examples.text: ye ariyasaccāni vibhāvayanti, gambhīrapaññena sudesitāni, kiñ'c'āpi te honti bhusaṃ pamattā, na te bhavaṃ aṭṭhamam'ādiyanti, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
ko imaṃ pathaviṃ vicessati, yamalokañ'ca imaṃ sadevakaṃ, ko dhammapadaṃ sudesitaṃ, kusalo puppham'iva pacessati.
yaṃ kho pana ayam'āyasmā dhammaṃ deseti, gambhīro so dhammo duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakk'āvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo, na so dhammo sudesiyo luddhenā'ti.

63904.commentary: (DNa) suddā suddā'ti tena ludd'ācārakamma-khudd'ācārakammunā suddaṃ suddaṃ lahuṃ lahuṃ kucchitaṃ gacchanti, vinassantī'ti attho.

mādisan'ti khattiyaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā vessaṃ vā suddaṃ vā.

63908.meaning2: slave of a man of the lowest class
63908.commentary: (DNt) tadev'idh'ādhippetaṃ, na rahassamantanaṃ sudd'ādīhi'pi suyyamānassa icchitattā. tena vuttaṃ atha āgaccheyya suddo vā suddadāso vā'tiādi.

examples.text: so tamhā padesā apakkamma ekam'antaṃ tiṭṭheyya. atha āgaccheyya suddo vā suddadāso vā, tasmiṃ padese ṭhito tadeva mantanaṃ manteyya, evam'pi rājā pasenadi kosalo āha, evam'pi rājā pasenadi kosalo āhā'ti. apinu so rājabhaṇitaṃ vā bhaṇati rājamantanaṃ vā manteti?

examples.text: iti kho, vāseṭṭha, evam'etassa suddamaṇḍalassa porāṇena aggaññena akkharena abhinibbatti ahosi tesaṃ'y'eva sattānaṃ anaññesaṃ, sadisānaṃ'y'eva no asadisānaṃ, dhammen'eva, no adhammena. dhammo hi, vāseṭṭha, seṭṭho janetasmiṃ diṭṭhe c'eva dhamme abhisamparāyañ'ca.

63911.meaning1: woman of the lowest caste; peasant woman

examples.text: tam'enaṃ evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, ambho purisa, yaṃ tvaṃ janapadakalyāṇiṃ icchasi kāmesi, jānāsi taṃ janapadakalyāṇiṃ khattiyī vā brāhmaṇī vā vessī vā suddī vā'ti? iti puṭṭho no'ti vadeyya.
yā'ti khattiyī vā brāhmaṇī vā vessī vā suddī vā.

examples.text: yo appaduṭṭhassa narassa dussati, suddhassa posassa anaṅgaṇassa, tam'eva bālaṃ pacceti pāpaṃ, sukhumo rajo paṭivātaṃ'va khitto.
passāmi suddhaṃ paramaṃ arogaṃ, diṭṭhena saṃsuddhi narassa hoti, ev'ābhijānaṃ paraman'ti ñatvā, suddh'ānupassī'ti pacceti ñāṇaṃ.
jiṇṇo'ham'asmi abalo vītavaṇṇo, nettā na suddhā savanaṃ na phāsu, m'āhaṃ nassaṃ momuho antarā'va, ācikkha dhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, jātijarāya idha vippahānaṃ.
veṇī nāma suddhakesā vā, suttamissā vā, mālāmissā vā, hiraññamissā vā, suvaṇṇamissā vā, muttāmissā vā, maṇimissā vā.
kiṃ nu satto'ti paccesi, māra diṭṭhigataṃ nu te, suddhasaṅkhārapuñjo'yaṃ, na'y'idha satt'upalabbhati.
aho vat'āyaṃ samīti yānakāraputto imissā nemiyā imañ'ca vaṅkaṃ imañ'ca jimhaṃ imañ'ca dosaṃ taccheyya, ev'āyaṃ nemi apagatavaṅkā apagatajimhā apagatadosā suddhā assa sāre patiṭṭhitā'ti.
punabbhavo jīvitaññāya, ekabījī ca suddhakaṃ, soto arahasambuddho, dve ca samaṇabrāhmaṇā'ti.
ajātā nāma pathavī, suddhapāsāṇā suddhasakkharā suddhakaṭhalā suddhamarumbā suddhavālikā appapaṃsukā appamattikā, yebhuyyenapāsāṇā, yebhuyyenasakkharā, yebhuyyenakaṭhalā
yo pana bhikkhu suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
navaṃ pana bhikkhunā santhataṃ kārayamānena dve bhāgā suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ ādātabbā, tatiyaṃ odātānaṃ, catutthaṃ gocariyānaṃ.

63942.meaning1: clean-living; living a pure life; innocent
63942.commentary: (DHPa) suddh'ājīvena passatā'ti evarūpo hi puggalo suddh'ājīvo nāma hoti. tena evaṃ suddh'ājīvena tam'eva suddh'ājīvaṃ sārato passatā lūkhajīvitavasena dujjīvaṃ hotī'ti attho.

63944.meaning1: name of five heavens in the Brahma realm

63945.meaning1: living in the pure land; of the pure abode

examples.text: evam'eva, suddh'āvāsesu devesu antarahitā bhagavato purato pāturahesuṃ. atha kho tā devatā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.

na kho pana so, sāriputta, saṃsāro sulabharūpo yo mayā asaṃsaritapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā, aññatra suddh'āvāsehi devehi. suddh'āvāse c'āhaṃ, sāriputta, deve saṃsareyyaṃ, na'y'imaṃ lokaṃ punarāgaccheyyaṃ.

63946.meaning1: belonging to the host of the pure land
63946.commentary: (SNa) suddh'āvāsakāyikānan'ti suddh'āvāsavāsīnaṃ. suddh'āvāsā nāma suddhānaṃ anāgāmikhīṇ'āsavānaṃ āvāsā pañca brahmalokā

63948.meaning1: purity; purification; holiness; epithet of Nibbāna

examples.text: idh'eva suddhi iti vādayanti, n'āññesu dhammesu visuddhim'āhu, yaṃ nissitā tattha subhaṃ vadānā, paccekasaccesu puthū niviṭṭhā.

ye kec'ime samaṇabrāhmaṇāse, diṭṭhassuten'āpi vadanti suddhiṃ, sīlabbatenāpi vadanti suddhiṃ, anekarūpena vadanti suddhiṃ, kacci'ssu te bhagavā tattha yatā carantā, atāru jātiñ'ca jarañ'ca mārisa, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.

63949.synonym: aneḷaka, abyāmissa, asambhinnaka, asecanaka, parisuddha, visada, vītaraja, saṃsuddha, suci, sucibhūta, sucīmant, suddha

63951.commentary: (SNa) suddhikabhāradvājo'ti ayam'pi bhāradvājo'va, suddhikapañhassa pana pucchitattā saṅgītikārehi evaṃ vutto.

examples.text: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho suddhikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ ajjhabhāsi

examples.text: dubhayāni viceyya paṇḍarāni, ajjhattaṃ bahiddhā ca suddhipañño, kaṇhaṃ sukkaṃ upātivatto, paṇḍito tādi pavuccate tathattā.

63967.meaning1: way to purity; path of purification; (or) clean path
63967.commentary: (THa) suddhimaggaṃ ajānanto, akāsiṃ amaraṃ tapan'ti suddhiyā nibbānassa maggaṃ ajānanto aggiparicaraṇaṃ viya pañcatapatappan'ādi-attakilamath'ānuyogaṃ suddhimaggo'ti maññāya akāsiṃ acariṃ paṭipajjiṃ. (NIDD1a) te suddhimaggan'ti te aññatitthiyā akiliṭṭhamaggaṃ.

examples.text: tapokammā apakkamma, yena na sujjhanti māṇavā, asuddho maññasi suddho, suddhimaggā aparaddho ti.
ayoni suddhim'anvesaṃ, aggiṃ paricariṃ vane, suddhimaggaṃ ajānanto, akāsiṃ amaraṃ tapaṃ.

63969.meaning2: name of the Buddha's father; name of the king of the Sakyans

taṃ hoti jātarūpaṃ sudhantaṃ niddhantaṃ nīhaṭaṃ ninnītakasāvaṃ mudu ca kammaññañ'ca pabhassarañ'ca

63971.commentary: (DNa) dhammassa ca sudhammatan'ti svākkhātat'ādi-bhedaṃ dhammassa sudhammataṃ ujuppaṭipannat'ādi-bhedaṃ saṅghassa ca suppaṭipattinti attho. (THa) passa dhammasudhammatan'ti tava satthu dhammassa sudhammabhāvaṃ svākkhātataṃ ek'anta-niyyānikataṃ passa, yattha anuvassiko tuvaṃ pabbajito.

examples.text: idaṃ disvāna nandanti, tāvatiṃsā sah'indakā, tathāgataṃ namassantā, dhammassa ca sudhammatan'ti.
tato cittaṃ vimucci me, passa dhammasudhammataṃ, tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan'ti.

63973.commentary: (MNa) sudhammāy'ābhito sabhan'ti sudhammasabhāya samīpe, ayaṃ pana brahmaloke sudhammasabhāva, na tāvatiṃsabhavane. sudhammasabhāvirahito hi devaloko nāma n'atthi.

examples.text: yo brahmaṃ paripucchati, sudhammāy'ābhito sabhaṃ, ajjā'pi ty'āvuso diṭṭhi, yā te diṭṭhi pure ahu, passasi vītivattantaṃ, brahmaloke pabhassaraṃ.
iṭṭhakāya chādentassa iṭṭhak'iṭṭhakāya āpatti pācittiyassa. silāya chādentassa silāya silāya āpatti pācittiyassa. sudhāya chādentassa piṇḍe piṇḍe āpatti pācittiyassa.

63998.meaning1: well pared; thoroughly stripped; well hewn

examples.text: tam'enaṃ dakkho goghātako vā goghātak'antevāsī vā aṭṭhikaṅkalaṃ sunikkantaṃ nikkantaṃ nimmaṃsaṃ lohitamakkhitaṃ upasumbheyya.

sunikkhittañ'ca padabyañjanaṃ attho ca sunīto. sunikkhittassa, bhikkhave, padabyañjanassa attho'pi sunayo hoti. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattantī'ti.
